children.label: coverage
children.description: Assesses the extent to which the humanitarian response reaches the target population and meets their needs.

children.label: appropriateness
children.description: Evaluates whether the humanitarian interventions are suitable and relevant to the context and needs of the affected population.

children.label: protection
children.description: Focuses on ensuring that humanitarian actions do not cause harm and that the rights and safety of affected populations are protected.

children.description: Measures the extent to which affected populations are involved in the planning, implementation, and monitoring of humanitarian activities.
